description: This file defines the AssignTemplateVariable class, a specialized expression node used in Twig templates for assigning variables, potentially at a global scope, during template compilation.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\Variable\AssignTemplateVariable
classes.description: A final class representing an assignment of a variable within a Twig template, capable of assigning to macros either locally or globally.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an AssignTemplateVariable node, encapsulating the variable to assign and whether the assignment is global.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the assignment expression into PHP code for rendering, assigning the variable to the macros array either locally or globally.
